title: Pass or Pounce
story: Two attackers approach two treasure doors while one guardian decides which danger to stop.
setup: Create two 12x16-yard fields with two mini goals at one end. Play 2v1 toward the goals, with spare balls at the starting end.
instructions: Two attackers enter together against one defender and may score in either goal.
The player on the ball may dribble, pass or shoot; the teammate finds a different route to goal.
If the defender wins it, dribble over the starting line to score.
End after a score or ball out, then rotate one attacker into defense.
coach_lens: Look for the teammate without the ball creating a clear second choice and the ball carrier reading the defender rather than passing automatically.
questions: What did the guardian leave open?
Where can you move to offer a different route?

simplify: Widen the field and goals or begin with a walking defender.
challenge: Move the goals farther apart so the supporting run must be clearer.
low_attendance: Play one field and rotate the defender after every round.
high_attendance: Duplicate the 2v1; do not expand into one crowded game.
limited_equipment: Use cone gates and return balls from behind the goals between rounds.

safety: Keep spare balls outside the playing area and retrieve them only after a round.
Use standing challenges and ground-level shots.

diagram.alt: Two attackers face one defender and two goals; arrows show a dribble toward one goal and a pass to the supporting attacker near the other.

source.title: Plan and Create a Training Session
source.reviewer_notes: SmallSide-authored directional 2v1 using U.S. Soccer guidance on game-like problems, fewer defenders, space adjustment and player decisions. No source wording or artwork reproduced.
